title: Generative adversarial networks with Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification for structural health monitoring: Fibre Bragg grating data augmentation comparison in Hawk T1A aircraft
abstract: arXiv:2610.22436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The signal generation capabilities of a novel data augmentation framework are examined in aerospace structures. First, the framework learns class-conditional temporal and spectral characteristics of the measured structural responses. It uses conditional generative adversarial network training and Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification as a Bayesian approximation. This step enables stochastic signal synthesis and uncertainty quantification. Second, the generated responses are rigorously compared against experimental measurements across time, frequency, uncertainty, variability, and feature domains to assess physical realism, statistical consistency, and distributional fidelity. Finally, the synthetic data are evaluated to determine whether they should be incorporated into a supervised damage classification workflow. The framework is validated on the full-scale benchmark dataset from a BAE Systems Hawk T1A aircraft tested at the Un

translated_title: 基于蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性量化的生成对抗网络用于结构健康监测：Hawk T1A飞机光纤布拉格光栅数据增强对比研究
translated_abstract: 本文在航空航天结构中考察了一种新颖数据增强框架的信号生成能力。首先，该框架通过条件生成对抗网络训练并以蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性量化作为贝叶斯近似，学习所测结构响应的类条件时域与频域特征，这一步骤实现了随机信号合成与不确定性量化。其次，将生成的结构响应与实验测量结果在时间、频率、不确定性、变异性和特征域上进行严格对比，以评估其物理真实性、统计一致性和分布保真度。最后，对合成数据进行评估，以确定其是否应被纳入有监督的损伤分类工作流程。该框架在BAE Systems Hawk T1A飞机全尺寸基准数据集上得到了验证。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合条件生成对抗网络与蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性量化的数据增强框架，在Hawk T1A飞机全尺寸数据集上验证了其生成的光纤布拉格光栅响应信号具有物理真实性和统计一致性，可有效用于结构健康监测中的损伤分类。
en_tdlr: A novel data augmentation framework combining conditional generative adversarial networks with Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification is proposed for structural health monitoring, demonstrating that synthetically generated Fibre Bragg grating responses on the full-scale Hawk T1A aircraft dataset achieve physical realism and statistical consistency for damage classification.
